svg.title: Europe's five highest GDPs per capita, 1952
svg.desc: A plot combining bar chart and text-label plot. It plots 6 - rank (vertical axis) against GDP per capita (1990 dollars) (horizontal axis), where colour shows country. Based on 5 observations.
